options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(os_user_domain_name) or I(os_project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* e

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Availability Zone of a cluster.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: flavor
options.description: Cluster flavor (node type).

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: name
options.description: Cluster name. It contains 4 to 32 characters. Only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are allowed. The value must start with a letter.

options.name: network
options.description: Name or ID of the neutron network

options.name: num_cn
options.description: Number of deployed CNs. The value ranges from 2 to the number of cluster nodes. The maximum value is 20 and the default value is 3.

options.name: num_nodes
options.description: Number of cluster nodes. For a cluster, the value ranges from 3 to 256. For a hybrid data warehouse (standalone), the value is 1.

options.name: password
options.description: Administrator password for logging in to a GaussDB(DWS) cluster. Contains 12 to 32 characters. Contains at least three types of the following characters uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Cannot be the same as the username or the username written in reverse order.

options.name: port
options.description: Service port of a cluster. The value ranges from 8000 to 30000. The default value is 8000.

options.name: public_ip
options.description: Public IP address. If the parameter is not specified, public connection is not used by default.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: router
options.description: Name or ID of the Neutron router (VPC)

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: security_group
options.description: Name or ID of the security group

options.name: state
options.description: Instance state

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags in a cluster.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time the module should wait for the cluster to get into active state.

options.name: username
options.description: Administrator username for logging in to a GaussDB(DWS) cluster. The administrator username must- Consist of lowercase letters, digits, or underscores. Start with a lowercase letter or an underscore. Contain 1 to 63 characters. Cannot be a keyword of the GaussDB(DWS) database.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(yes).

options.name: wait
options.description: If the module should wait for the cluster to be created.
